flavor_text.sun-moon: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.
flavor_text.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.
flavor_text.lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee: Enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
